rules.fixture_source: HotSpawn Pick'ems public fixtures endpoint (discovery only)
rules.probability_sources: external bookmakers / exchanges / fitted models — never HotSpawn
rules.join_rule: both team labels must match after canonicalisation (either orientation) and any published start time must be within ±240 min
rules.freshness_rule: market quotes older than 6 h and in-play prices are excluded
rules.devig_rule: per-source proportional no-vig (each raw implied probability ÷ overround)
rules.consensus_rule: arithmetic mean of per-source no-vig probabilities
rules.pick_rule: pick = higher published probability; an edge below 0.005 is published as a coin flip with no pick
rules.estimate_rule: Valve CS2 Regional Standings logistic (scale 400, a stated modelling assumption) or a Bradley-Terry fit on the bo3.gg results corpus
rules.hotspawn_crowd_pct: never read by any probability function

bt.model: Bradley-Terry (Zermelo/Hunter MM update) with exponential time decay and a 0.5 prior

evaluation.note: Out-of-sample window: the Bradley-Terry model used here is refitted with every match inside the window excluded, and the Valve VRS snapshot used predates the window. The book price pair bo3.gg keeps for a finished match is the last price it held (updated in-play), so it is deliberately NOT scored here as a benchmark - on 2026-10-14 it implied the eventual winner in 100% of 4,000 settled matches. Fewer model rows than matches in the window means the model had no rating for both teams.
